name: Intent Coverage Check
description: When a new skill is created, checks that the routing system has matching TaskType, intent patterns, skill mapping, and model config

then.prompt:
A new OpenClaw skill was just created. Check that the routing system is fully wired up for it:

1. Read the new skill file to get its name
2. Check doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/types.ts has a matching TaskType
3. Check doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/intent-detector.ts has intent patterns for it
4. Check doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/tool-router.ts has a skill mapping for it
5. Check doraemon/src/renderer/services/routing/constants.ts has a model config for it

If any are missing, add them following the existing patterns. The skill name in the frontmatter maps to the TaskType (with hyphens converted to underscores).
